description: This file is a C header file defining utility functions related to device information retrieval, such as getting device ID, model number, manufacturer, firmware version, MAC address, and partner ID. It also defines platform-dependent file paths and a function to check for multiple running instances.

methods.name: GetAccountID
methods.description: Retrieves the device's account ID into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: GetModelNum
methods.description: Retrieves the device's model number into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: GetMFRName
methods.description: Retrieves the device's manufacturer name into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: GetBuildType
methods.description: Retrieves the device's build type as a lowercase string, potentially also setting an enum indicating build type.

methods.name: GetFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version of the device into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: GetEstbMac
methods.description: Retrieves the device's Ethernet MAC address into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: GetPartnerId
methods.description: Retrieves the partner ID of the device into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: CurrentRunningInst
methods.description: Checks if another instance of a specified service lock file is already running.

methods.name: stripinvalidchar
methods.description: Removes invalid characters from a string buffer.
